query:
SELECT title, slug, 
  CASE 
    WHEN coverImageUrl IS NULL OR coverImageUrl = '' THEN 'NO IMAGE'
    ELSE 'HAS IMAGE'
  END as image_status
FROM news 
WHERE coverImageUrl IS NULL OR coverImageUrl = ''
ORDER BY date DESC;
